Our Story

Hi, we're Renata & Sridhar.

A Polish-Indian family living in the heart of Tamil Nadu. We took a leap of faith to settle in an Indian village and build a life close to nature, a city-born couple who quit the corporate world to raise a self-sustainable permaculture farm and a family of five.

“Whether you're growing your own food, learning old-fashioned skills, or just craving a simpler life, you're in the right place.”

Where the farm starts, our life starts. It isn't always glamorous or clean, but it is busy, entertaining and honest. We document all of it, dreams and confessions included.

Renata & Sridhar
Our mission

To live simply, sustainably, and a little closer to the roots.

Self-reliant, nature-based skills to make life healthier, calmer and more meaningful, wherever in the world you happen to live.

All Nature

No synthetic shortcuts: the farm, the food and the products all start with what the land already gives.

Stress Free

Slower mornings, monsoon-paced days, and a to-do list that answers to the seasons, not a calendar app.

Back to Roots

Old-fashioned, nature-based skills: food forests, home remedies, hand-made everything.

Cultural Balance

One Polish, one Tamil, one home, two worlds compared, blended and loved in the open.

Visitor Notes

What visitors say

"We spent three quiet days walking barefoot on the red earth and waking up to the smell of rain. Renata's fresh sourdough and the garden herbal teas completely reset our nervous systems."

Ananya & Karthik · Bangalore

"Seeing how Sridhar works with the monsoon swales and living soil was eye-opening. You do not just visit a farm here, you learn what it truly means to live in rhythm with the land."

David M. · Auroville

"The stillness here is something rare. We left with our bags smelling of cold-process neem soaps, jars of raw forest honey, and hearts full of calm. An unforgettable stay with Renata and Sridhar."

Priya Sundaram · Chennai

"I came expecting a weekend getaway and left with a completely different relationship with food. Watching Renata grind spices at dawn and Sridhar explain why each plant grows where it does changed something in me. I have not bought a vegetable from a supermarket since."

Meera Nair · Kochi
